events.title: You Can Now Retry a Wave
events.summary: You can now retry a wave from the pause menu and the game over screen. You can revise your layout and try again without restarting the entire stage, so use this option if you make an accidental mistake. events.title: Patch Notes: Faster Load Times, Performance Optimization & Control Guide Improvements
events.summary: An update for "Welcome to HELL RESORT!" is now live, featuring faster loading times, performance optimizations for large enemy waves, and improved control guide ergonomics. Key Updates Faster Loading & Smoother Scene TransitionsOptimized loading times during startup and scene transitions, significantly reducing wait times for a smoother gameplay experience. Performance Optimization for Large CrowdsImproved internal processing to reduce slowdowns and frame drops when large waves of sinners appear

events.title: Mechanics in Development: Electric Facilities and Power Stations
events.summary: Today, we'd like to introduce electric facilities, one of the mechanics currently in development. Electric facilities are a special type of facility. They require a power station and must be built within its supply range. The timing of attacks also depends on the power supplied by the station. events.title: Demo Update: 13 Language Options
events.summary: The free demo of Welcome to Hell Resort! has been updated with more language options and clearer, illustrated in-game explanations. Expanded to 13 language options Alongside Japanese, English, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese, the demo now supports these nine additional language and regional options: Thai Korean Russian French German Ukrainian Portuguese (Brazil) Spanish (Spain) Spanish (Latin America) The translations cover menus, control instructions, dialogue, stage and facility names,

events.title: You Can Play on Steam Deck!
events.summary: Welcome to Hell Resort! supports play on Steam Deck. The developer also uses a Steam Deck regularly for testing and debugging. Controls and UI readability are being refined through testing on the actual device. The free demo is also playable on Steam Deck. If you have a Steam Deck, give it a try!

events.title: The Free Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: The free demo for Welcome to Hell Resort! is now available on Steam! It includes a tutorial and eight stages from the main game. If you've been curious about the game, please give it a try. We plan for the demo and full game to share save data, so you can carry your demo progress over to the full release. In Endless Mode, you earn rewards every 10 waves. Collect rewards, use them to grow stronger, and keep playing! We'd love to hear what you think. Tell us what you enjoyed, what was challenging,
